items.name: fluticasone nasal spray, 120 sprays

items.name: ovulation test strips, 20 count
items.note: Not named in the sources; fertility testing is includible when used to overcome an inability to have children, but routine family planning use isn't clearly covered.

items.name: large eggs, dozen
items.note: Food that is normally consumed to satisfy nutritional needs isn't medical care.

items.name: children's acetaminophen suspension, 4 oz
items.note: Children's OTC medicines are OTC medicines, eligible after 2019.

items.name: toilet safety rail
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: adult multivitamin, 100 count
items.note: Vitamins and supplements aren't includible unless recommended by a medical practitioner as treatment for a specific diagnosed condition.

items.name: fingertip pulse oximeter
items.note: A pulse oximeter is a device used in diagnosing and monitoring illness.
